findings.issue: api() memoizes the promise before it settles and never evicts rejected ones; one transient API failure permanently poisons that resource (and getIndex/getTypes, which every list page depends on) until restart. No test covers the non-404 error path.
findings.suggestion: In the catch path, delete the cache entry before rethrowing; add a Vitest test that stubs fetch to fail once then succeed.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled concurrency limiter (waiter queue, manual counter, release in finally) gates every API call; a small refactor can deadlock SSR or remove the limit entirely, with no test to notice.
findings.suggestion: Unit test with fake fetches asserting max in-flight never exceeds MAX_CONCURRENT and all queued calls complete, or replace with a small tested pool utility.

findings.issue: buildIndex joins 1025 species with type records, generations and slot dedupe/ordering; alternate forms are excluded only implicitly via the speciesById lookup. Any permutation bug renders plausible-looking wrong data.
findings.suggestion: Add fixture-based unit tests for buildIndex: alternate forms (ID > 10000) excluded, type slots sorted by slot, generation fallback, entries sorted by dex number.

findings.issue: idFromUrl returns NaN on unexpected URL shapes and feeds Record<number, SpeciesRef> lookups; format drift would silently drop cards instead of erroring.
findings.suggestion: Table-driven tests for the trailing-slash and no-slash cases plus the NaN fallback, and decide whether NaN should be surfaced as an error.

findings.issue: Query-state handling is untested: parseInt accepts 'page=2abc', pageCount clamping via Math.min, and the slice bounds for pageItems.
findings.suggestion: Unit tests for the page/filter/pagination computeds covering invalid, zero, negative and out-of-range page values and multi-filter combinations.

findings.issue: Two-way sync between route.query.q and the q ref plus a 200ms debounced router.push is a feedback-loop hazard (e.g. stale push overwriting a filter changed in the same window).
findings.suggestion: Component test with @nuxt/test-utils: type a query, change type filter mid-debounce, assert the final URL preserves both.

findings.issue: Move-table transformation (version-group filter, dedupe via Map, per-method sort keys, METHOD_ORDER ranking with localeCompare tiebreak) is dense boundary-condition logic with no coverage.
findings.suggestion: Extract into a testable function in lib/ and unit test: empty moves, level ties, unknown method names, no games at all.

findings.issue: Card-mapping logic (dedupe, form drop, sort) is copy-pasted from speciesCardsForRefs instead of reusing it, so the two can silently diverge.
findings.suggestion: Reuse speciesCardsForRefs and add a shared test; abilities only need the extra is_hidden flag layered on.

findings.issue: Pure helpers (humanize, latestEnFlavor with \f/\n collapsing, 'last English entry' semantics) have edge cases (ho-oh, porygon2, hyphen-only tokens) pinned by nothing.
findings.suggestion: One-line table-driven Vitest cases each; this is the cheapest possible safety net and should have been the first test written.

findings.issue: RELATIONS is a literal mapping of API keys to labels; a typo in a key silently renders 'None' for a damage relation, and the EXCLUDED_TYPES guard for stellar/shadow/unknown is untested.
findings.suggestion: Assert the six relation lists against a type fixture with known damage_relations, and that /types/stellar yields the 404 path.

summary: The app ships no tests whatsoever, despite current Nuxt 4 / @nuxt/test-utils v4 + Vitest making both runtime component tests and plain unit tests of the framework-free data layer straightforward to add. The untested code is the riskiest in the repo: a hand-rolled fetch limiter, a promise cache that never evicts failures (a latent bug in itself), a 1025-species index cross-join, URL-state pagination, and dense move-table sorting. Only the externally-owned Playwright suite guards any of this, so a data-layer refactor today would pass with no failing signal.
